description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called RevealOnBuild that animates the appearance of its child widget with a fade-in and slide effect based on build timing, incorporating motion tokens for configurable durations.

classes.name: RevealOnBuild
classes.description: A stateless widget that animates its child with a fade-in and upward translation when built, respecting user motion preferences.

methods.description: Builds the animated widget, applying opacity and translation transforms based on animation timing calculations.
